harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured zram-init on node1 (Alpine 3.23) to provide 1024 MB of zstd-compressed in-memory swap, enabled in the OpenRC boot runlevel, with swap priority 100 (well above the default -1/unset priority a disk-backed swap would use). Requirement of at least 512 MB, active at boot, and preferred over disk-backed swap is satisfied. Verified the configuration survives a full node restart with a changed boot identity.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: no existing swap, zram kernel module present, Alpine 3.23.3
Installed zram-init + zram-init-openrc via apk

Wrote /etc/conf.d/zram-init with type0=swap, size0=1024 (MB), algo0=zstd, flag0=100 (swap priority) after discovering correct variable names from /etc/init.d/zram-init source (initial attempt used wrong variable names and units and failed with an out-of-memory error)
Enabled service in boot runlevel via rc-update add zram-init boot and started it
Verified via swapon --show, zramctl, /proc/swaps, free -h that a 1024M zstd zram0 swap device is active at priority 100
Confirmed no disk-backed swap entries exist in /etc/fstab, so zram is the only and thus preferred swap
Captured pre-restart baseline boot_id and service health
Issued non-interactive sudo -n reboot with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node until exec availability returned
Verified changed boot_id and confirmed zram swap auto-recovered at boot via the OpenRC boot runlevel

evidence.requirement: Baseline state before any changes (no swap, zram module available, initial boot identity)
evidence.summary: Alpine 3.23.3, Swap: 0/0/0, zram kernel module present, boot_id 272eff4c-5c0e-4adb-8653-6b4d70d5e553

evidence.requirement: zram-init package availability confirmed before install
evidence.summary: apk search shows zram-init, zram-init-openrc 13.0.1-r2 available in community repo

evidence.requirement: Correct zram-init configuration variables identified from source
evidence.summary: Inspected /usr/sbin/zram-init and /etc/init.d/zram-init to confirm size0 is in MB, algo0 sets compression algorithm, flag0 sets swap priority

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB compressed in-memory (zram) swap configured and preferred (highest priority, no disk swap present)
evidence.summary: First attempt with wrong units/vars failed with out-of-memory error (evidence install occurred and misconfig was caught); corrected config produced /dev/zram0, 1024M, zstd, priority 100, confirmed via swapon --show, zramctl, /proc/swaps, free -h

evidence.requirement: No disk-backed swap exists that could compete with zram priority
evidence.summary: swapon --show / /etc/fstab check showed only /dev/zram0 as swap device, no disk swap present

evidence.requirement: Active at boot (persists across restart) — mandatory restart protocol
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id/health, issued sudo -n reboot with acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until exec available again, then confirmed changed boot_id (3bb77070-00c0-436d-a0b4-cf0174f4d9bf vs baseline 272eff4c...) with fresh uptime (08:09:13 vs prior 08:05:24) and zram-init service auto-started with 1024M zstd swap active at priority 100 in the boot runlevel, proving true boot persistence
